{{short description|American mathematician}}
'''Joseph Lehner''' (October 29, 1912, New York City – August 5, 2013, Haverford, PA) was a mathematician at [[Michigan State University]] (1957–1963),
the [[University of Maryland]] (1963–1972), and the [[University of Pittsburgh]] (1972–1980). He  worked on [[automorphic function]]s and introduced [[Atkin–Lehner theory]].
